About Naturaus

A Sydney base for Australia–overseas business

Naturaus Pty Ltd is based in Bella Vista, in Sydney's north-west. We work with cosmetic brands, manufacturers and trading partners who need a reliable contact on the ground in Australia — for advice, sourcing, import & export coordination, and brand protection.

Whether you are developing a cosmetic product, looking for quality raw materials, or registering a trademark in Australia, you deal directly with us from first enquiry to delivery.

How we work

Simple, direct, and in writing

Most work starts with a short email. From there we confirm what is possible, what it will cost, and the next step — before you commit to anything.

1

Tell us what you need

Email or call with your product, material, quantity, destination or trademark — even a rough idea is enough to start.

2

We check & advise

We source options, check specifications and availability, and come back with clear advice, pricing indications and timelines where available.

3

Proceed with confidence

If it stacks up, we coordinate the order, shipment, application or next stage — and keep you updated along the way.
